references.text: The Lord said to Aaron that the Levites should have no inheritance in the land, because the Lord himself was their inheritance and portion among the children of Israel.
The Levites received the tithe from Israel as their inheritance, because they had no other share among the people.
The Israelites were to rejoice before the Lord together with the Levites living among them, because the Levite had no inheritance with them.
Exhortation not to forget the Levite, which repeats the command to care for the Levites who had no inheritance.
The tribe of Levi received no inheritance with their brothers because the Lord is their inheritance, as the Lord had promised.
Levitical priests were to have no inheritance share with Israel, but the Lord was their inheritance and they were to live from the offerings.
Confirmation that the tribe of Levi received no inheritance, because the Lord's fire offering was their inheritance.
